name: Midwest Sheet Metal Co
old_description: Midwest Sheet Metal's Machine Shop is a complete, full service facility, specializing in custom tool and die, jigs and fixtures.  We are a  leading provider of innovative, practical, quality machining and fabrication.  No job is too big or too small.  Each job is given an unwavering level of attention to detail.  Over the years, Midwest Sheet Metal is proud to have earned a loyal customer base built on service, knowledge, trust, quality workmanship and competitive pricing.   We have trained, skilled and experienced personnel, with the right equipment, tools and knowledge to efficiently achieve your product goals.
about:
Midwest Sheet Metal Company operates from Springfield, Missouri, in the heart of the Ozark Mountain region. The business is a second-generation, family-owned operation; Jan Davis’s father, Dave, began his career there in 1957 and owned the company for more than 25 years. Today, Chris and Jan Davis have led the firm for over 15 years, continuing a legacy of custom fabrication and machining that the company describes as spanning more than 50 years.

The shop provides a full range of metal fabrication and precision machining services. Its capabilities include custom fabrication, a full-service machine shop, precision tool and die work, prototype design and fabrication, shearing, cutting, bending, forming, punching, sawing, rolling, and welding. The facility maintains a large in-stock inventory of aluminum (including Tread Brite and colored grades), stainless steel, carbon steel, and structural shapes, and the company notes it is the area’s largest supplier of Aluminum Tread Brite. A deep bench of personnel—many with 10 to 20-plus years of tenure—supports the operation, which also houses a machine shop specializing in jigs, fixtures, special tooling, and die repair.

Midwest Sheet Metal serves customers across a variety of industries, with product lines that include racing components and custom semi-truck sunvisors. The machine shop’s expertise in automotive stampings, fuel-injection parts, and small electric motor components further reflects a client base in automotive racing, heavy trucking, and general industrial manufacturing.

The company emphasizes its combination of scale and personal attention: a broad inventory and full-service capacity paired with one-to-one customer service. Its differentiators include a multi-decade workforce, extensive press-brake tooling, and a reputation for craftsmanship delivered at competitive prices.
